tiers.note: The Commission publishes this tier as a choice between two fees without saying on this page which filing draws which. The figure for Articles of Organization has not been read from a page that states it.

evidence.quote: Next Day: Pay the fee ($50 or $100) Submit by 2:00PM EST to receive a filing response by 4:00PM EST the following business day

tiers.turnaround: receive a filing response by 4:00PM EST the same business day

evidence.quote: Same Day: Pay the fee ($200) Submit by 10:00AM EST to receive a filing response by 4:00PM EST the same business day

notes: Virginia sells expedited service only on filings submitted online through its Clerk's Information System; the Commission states plainly that a paper submission may not be expedited, which makes the channel part of the offer rather than a detail. Expedite fees are nonrefundable and a resubmission is not automatically expedited, so a rejected filing costs the fee twice. The Next Day tier is published as a choice of two fees rather than one.
